## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Universal Wallet Support

**Figma frame:** _Universal Wallet Support_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Wallet compatibility showcase (supported wallets list/cards) with icons and compatibility messaging.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Compatibility heading, supporting copy, and supported-wallet presentation.
- Wallet cards or list items with icon, name, and compatibility information.
- Responsive behavior that keeps wallet information easy to scan.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile wallet-compatibility frames.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Supported wallets are easy to identify and compare
- [ ] Icons, names, and compatibility messaging are consistently aligned
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens, UI-19 components where applicable, and UI-20 grid rules
- [ ] Dark-mode contrast is sufficient for icons, labels, and supporting text
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
